title: Finland's ski holiday weeks 2027: dates by city and Lapland stays
seoTitle: Finland ski holiday weeks 2027: school winter break dates
description: Finland ski holiday weeks 2027: Helsinki and Turku are off 22–26 February, Tampere 1–5 March, Oulu and Rovaniemi 8–12 March. What that means for Lapland stays.
dek: Finland's school winter holiday comes in three waves from late February to mid-March. At a ski resort the week starts on the Saturday before.
heroAlt: Dark timber-clad apartment buildings along a street in the centre of Levi at dusk: a thin first snow on the roofs and the pavement, lights in the windows and by the doors, the steep roof of St Mary's Chapel and a misty spruce forest behind.
heroCaption: Apartment buildings in the centre of Levi next to St Mary's Chapel during the first snow in October 2026.

body.text: Finland's school winter holiday, known as hiihtoloma or the ski holiday, comes in three parts in 2027: weeks 8, 9 and 10. According to the Finnish National Agency for Education, the holiday is staggered across these three weeks, and each municipality decides its own week. For anyone booking a stay in Lapland, that means three consecutive weeks of domestic peak season.

items: Week 8
22–26 February 2027

body.text: The dark bar is the school holiday from Monday to Friday. The light bar is the ski holiday week in Ruka's calendar, from a Saturday to the Sunday of the following week.

The dates come from the agency's list, which covers the regional capitals of mainland Finland plus Espoo and Vantaa. The cities of Helsinki, Tampere and Oulu give the same dates on their own websites. The agency nevertheless calls the list indicative, so check your own municipality's week on its website before you book. Holidays at upper secondary schools, vocational colleges and pre-primary education can differ from those of comprehensive schools.
At a ski resort the week starts on Saturday

The school holiday runs from Monday to Friday, but families set off the weekend before. In its own calendar, Ruka marks the ski holiday weeks from a Saturday to the Sunday of the following week. In the boxes above, that is the light bar.

Consecutive weeks therefore overlap at the weekends: on Saturday 27 February and Saturday 6 March the resort has both departing and arriving holidaymakers. Search for accommodation for the whole span of your week, not just the school holiday days.
Ski holiday in Lapland: what the weeks mean

Week 8 brings the Helsinki region and Turku, week 9 Tampere and most of the other regional capitals. In week 10 it is the turn of Oulu and Rovaniemi and, for example, Kittilä, the home municipality of Levi, where the winter holiday is 8–14 March 2027. According to Yle, Levi and Ruka are Finland's clear top two resorts by skier days, with Ylläs the third largest.

The season shows in prices. According to preliminary figures from Statistics Finland, Lapland's hotel rooms were the most expensive in the country in March 2026, and the region recorded the second highest number of overnight stays in Finland after Uusimaa.

body.text: How to book a stay for a ski holiday week

items: First confirm your own municipality's week on the municipality's or the school's website.
If someone in the family is at upper secondary school or vocational college, check that school's holiday separately: it can fall in a different week from the comprehensive school holiday.
Search for a stay that runs from Saturday to Sunday if you want to travel at the weekend.
If your dates are flexible, look at the time before 20 February or after mid-March. The school winter holidays end on 14 March, and Easter is 26–29 March 2027.
Alongside Levi, Ruka and Ylläs, compare other resorts such as Pyhä-Luosto, Saariselkä and Salla.

body.text: Visiting from abroad: Finnish school holidays are Lapland's domestic peak

Finns traditionally take their winter holiday in weeks 8–10, and that is when Finnish families compete for the cabins and hotels at the ski resorts. The resorts also build their own programme around these weeks: according to Ruka, there are events for families with children during the ski holiday weeks both at the ski resort and elsewhere in Kuusamo. If you are coming to Lapland from abroad and your dates are not fixed, plan your trip outside 20 February–14 March 2027 and you will not be booking the same weeks as Finnish families with schoolchildren.
Our cabins page explains what a rental cabin in Lapland includes and how Levi, Ylläs, Ruka and Saariselkä differ as cabin destinations.
